user_stories.benefit: new clients can view and complete onboarding steps easily
valid government IDs are accepted without manual review
the application meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards and is usable by all users
the entire onboarding process is automated and reduces manual effort

risk_register.description: Delay in receiving third‑party payment vendor API credentials and sandbox access, blocking backend integration and threatening the release date
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Escalate to vendor account manager, request expedited delivery, and set up a mock integration to keep development on track

risk_register.description: Chosen UI component library may not fully meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements, potentially requiring mid‑project replacement
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Evaluate alternative libraries early, conduct an accessibility audit, and plan for a replacement if needed

risk_register.description: Staging environment instability has blocked QA regression testing for multiple days, delaying testing and quality assurance
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: File an infrastructure ticket, set up monitoring, and allocate buffer time for testing

risk_register.description: Automated KYC document verification rejects valid government IDs due to image compression degrading scan quality, blocking end‑to‑end onboarding
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Adjust compression settings, add validation checks, and test with a variety of ID images

risk_register.description: If vendor credential delay is not resolved within five business days, the end‑of‑month release date is at risk of slipping by 1–2 weeks
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Implement a contingency plan, adjust the schedule, and communicate the risk to stakeholders

risk_register.description: Payment gateway integration is behind schedule because the vendor has not yet shared updated API credentials, creating a critical path risk
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Prioritize credential acquisition, allocate additional resources, and monitor progress closely

risk_register.description: Potential need to replace the UI library mid‑development if accessibility compliance cannot be achieved, impacting scope and quality
risk_register.mitigation_suggestion: Plan for a mid‑development switch, allocate buffer time, and evaluate libraries early
